title: Blackstone's Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown | TechCrunch
summary: Building on its success with CoreWeave, Blackstone struck other neocloud financing deals, including co-leading alongside Coatue a $10 billion credit facility for Australian GPU provider Firmus earlier this year. Concerns about the rising cost of debt have spilled into the stock market.
